todos.text: Map Elastic Dream, OceAura and NOVAHAIR to their exact Shopify products and verify historical sales ranking
notes: Shopify analytics confirmed Elastic Dream #1 by orders and OceAura #2 among named products.

todos.text: Locate the Dopamodoro web/app repository and verify its task priority, groups and completed-history system
notes: Existing todo schema supports priority, notes, subtasks, dueDate, groupId and completedAt.

todos.text: Build the independent customer-data architecture so Shopify is a commerce system, not the only copy of customer data
notes: Target architecture: Shopify + Tally + Google Forms + legacy sources -> owned database -> selective sync back to Shopify.
Do not store raw customer PII in Git history.

subtasks.text: Define encrypted backup strategy independent of Shopify
Define incremental sync and reconciliation jobs

todos.text: Verify historical-order API access and prepare full Shopify customer + order export for the owned database
notes: Historical Shopify analytics are available back through the Elastic Dream and OceAura selling periods. Next step is verifying order-level/customer-level access for the same old period before export.
Export target includes customers, orders, line items, discounts, refunds, fulfillment, consent, tags and relevant metafields.

subtasks.text: Label customer cohorts by Elastic Dream / OceAura / Nova purchase history

todos.text: Map complementary products bought with Elastic Dream and identify cross-sell relationships from order history
notes: The 4-in-1 hyaluronic serum has a strong historical timing overlap with Elastic Dream sales. Exact co-purchase relationships still require an order-level line-item join.

todos.text: Verify the live Tally survey as a readable data source

todos.text: Connect Tally submissions to the owned database and selectively enrich Shopify customer records
notes: Raw survey response stays in the owned database; only useful normalized attributes should be written back to Shopify tags/metafields.
